title: The D23 v2 comparison runs K, P and P-with-brief three times each on about 150 derivable units
body:
Why: n100 (t-v41ny8g) showed no difference at a 10% floor with only 6-7 discordant pairs; Miller (https://arxiv.org/html/2411.00640): repeated runs per unit cut the detectable effect from ~13 to ~7.5 pp at n~200.
Outcome: a new preregistered protocol under .krn/runs/d23-comparison/v2/protocol.md (written before any arm runs): units = D/P after requirements (fresh units beyond n100 where needed to reach ~150), arms K (fixed refusals, t-bktyjsj), P, P+requirements brief same text as K; 3 runs per unit and arm; primary = paired per-unit mean correctness, clustered SE; secondary = scope-clean, refusal rate, cost per correct unit.
Proof: regrade prints per-arm means with CI and the paired test p.
Scope: evals/d23/, test/evals/, .krn/runs/d23-comparison/v2/.

Observation 2026-11-12 run1: arm sessions answer in Polish, so the operator's global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md loads in every arm (K, P, PB alike); a shared condition, not a treatment difference, but name it in the verdict.

Disk 2026-11-12: unit clones before #560 run a test that copies Codex home (737M) into /mnt/storage/tmp/krn/krn-mock-provider-* and never removes it (14.7G leaked). .krn/runs/d23-comparison/v2/tmp-reaper.sh removes such dirs older than 30 min while the driver runs; it does not touch /mnt/storage/tmp/d23.

Decision 2026-11-12 22:10 (operator: do not burn quota): run1 only, as a diagnostic; runs 2-3 cancelled before any grading; per-unit K losses become fix tasks; the 3-run confirmatory comparison reruns on a newly frozen K. Amendment in .krn/runs/d23-comparison/v2/protocol.md.

Grader audit 2026-11-12: grading valid (n100 failures are real fail-to-pass assertion failures; full-suite regressions compared with the parent). Known limit: overlay copies only test/ paths, so a hidden test needing a non-test fixture fails with ENOENT (n100 at most K 5, P 4 runs). Not changed, because such files can be the deliverable (FR-40 manifest); the run1 report lists ENOENT-only failures as their own category. Research round 2: .krn/runs/d23-comparison/research-2.md; levers t-jskrfrm t-rmt64gs t-kmsa30s t-xra6acz.
Main checkout frozen at d562d50 until run1 ends (replay.sh uses the main checkout's evals/d23/harness.ts; 8bb6ccc changes it). See .krn/runs/d23-comparison/v2/MAIN-FROZEN.txt.

2026-11-13 05:05: quota binds throughput (12 sessions spend the 5-hour window in ~20 min); remainder of run1 runs arms K and PB only (protocol amendment). Grade loop: v2/grade-loop.sh; restart waiter: v2/restart-wait.sh.
